capture_model_and_bounds.capability: Communicate what the actual preview/capture method establishes and its material limits.
capture_model_and_bounds.one: The delivered record identifies or unambiguously explains engine-state/texture CPU reconstruction versus actual GPU framebuffer evidence, and binds its claims to supported features/coverage. A concrete invocation of the same supplied exporter on the delivered project is sufficient model/bounds identification because original client-handover paragraph12 already documents its CPU construction and shader/occlusion limitations. Repeating that explanation is not required. Equivalent concise prose, tables, metadata, procedures and actual alternative render evidence count.
capture_model_and_bounds.half: A real producer and some useful scope are recoverable, but a material capture/assurance boundary genuinely remains unexplained after considering the available original client/tool context, for example an altered producer or unsupported-feature claim. This is incomplete evidence quality, not a false GPU claim. Absence of repeated paragraph12 alone is never such a gap.
capture_model_and_bounds.zero: No useful capture provenance/scope, or a material adopted false rendering-assurance claim.
capture_model_and_bounds.limits: Do not require the words GPU/Pillow or a laundry list of irrelevant features. Do not demand framebuffer evidence for a claim already supported by the actual capture model. Correct runtime source code alone is not a client-facing explanation of what evidence proves.

independent_observation_evidence.capability: Support claimed repairs through externally observed objects, time intervals and event payloads instead of candidate status/counters alone.
independent_observation_evidence.one: Actual evidence, including authentic trusted external history as well as retained client records, supports the substantive claimed visual/instance/timing/event distinctions with independent observations and relevant before/after or issue-to-verification correspondence. Equivalent engine traces, valid tests, measured images and concise bound reports count.
independent_observation_evidence.half: Useful independent evidence supports part of the claims, but another material distinction remains only asserted or inferred from candidate-private bookkeeping without adequate cross-checks. Failure to ship a reusable procedure belongs only to the separate procedure unit, not here.
independent_observation_evidence.zero: Only self-reported success/status or evidence incapable of supporting the claimed repairs.
independent_observation_evidence.limits: Actual node paths, references, identities or equivalent observations count; no mandatory numeric instance-ID field. Delivered logs and traces plus a concrete operable command may establish execution correspondence without private author-history command IDs. Do not demand a new exact test input or penalize the same C09/C15 functional defect again. A test may be good evidence even when it correctly reveals a remaining failure.

actionable_reproduction_context.capability: Hand over a reusable independent public-API regression procedure, distinct from the already credited basic preview export.
actionable_reproduction_context.one: The receiver has a concrete viable execution and observation route for meaningful stand-alone public-API regression. Equivalent shipped or inline test sources, adequate concise manual setup/call/listener/cleanup steps, structured procedures and valid accessible links count; enough build/tool context must resolve the route. Exact shell syntax or a custom harness is not mandatory. Original required actions/expected results support the method but do not by themselves supply a missing execution/listener route.
actionable_reproduction_context.half: Useful API inputs, actions, expected/observed results and project/tool context are available, but a material bridge for executing or observing the stand-alone calls is missing. For example the receiver must design the missing listener/test-driving logic rather than merely follow supplied steps. Original checklist action/observation rows plus method signatures can provide this partial capability; they do not automatically establish a full executable/manual procedure.
actionable_reproduction_context.zero: No reusable independent API regression procedure is retained or meaningfully specified, or the identified procedure is materially unusable. This does not erase actual private testing or correct basic export/functional delivery.
actionable_reproduction_context.limits: No mandatory test-script filename, extra document, hash format, second export or prescribed tool. Detailed reproducible API steps with expected observations may be complete even if a temporary harness was not shipped. Original client requirements and supplied tools are available context. Authentic unshipped history validates truth but does not magically become a delivered client procedure.

ownership: Physical orientation and ordinary-demo timing are already owned by C09 and C15. Do not create another handover defect solely from those same failures or a generic Completed claim. Judge independent factual handover accuracy and evidence quality. Repetition of one erroneous resource assertion is one fact, not several errors. The three professional subunits are complementary observations, not three separate damage charges: capture_model_and_bounds owns producer/model/claim scope; independent_observation_evidence owns actual observable relations; actionable_reproduction_context owns transfer of a reusable independent regression procedure. Missing a build hash does not negate real observations or an identified capture model and is not automatically a failure. Missing a retained procedure affects only the procedure unit. Basic working exporter commands and functional delivery retain their existing credit. Any later aggregation must follow actual project policy and natural ownership, not a cap imported from another task.
capture_assurance_ownership: Capture construction or assurance assertions are classified capture_model_assurance and owned only by capture_model_and_bounds, the capture subunit of C13. Their same cause is excluded from C14 assertion accuracy, ticket summary accuracy and independent-observation completeness. This applies to both overstated fidelity and false claimed renderer limitations; actual rendered correspondence remains separately creditable.
sampling_policy: Use the original API Contract tolerance: end-time observations allow one60Hz sampling interval, position0.05pixels and direction0.0001radians. Nominal duration wording and roundoff within that declared resolution are not separately false reporting. A genuinely wrong multi-tick absence interval or unrelated claimed result remains independently reviewable.
claim_policy: Review affirmative adopted handover claims only, with separate adopted_claim_citations restricted to actual delivered handover documents. Configuration or trace values are not automatically adopted prose assertions. No count, warning or source-FPS disclaimer is required merely to avoid an error. 73 original input PNGs and69 played frame slots are compatible. Delivery30FPS does not establish unknown original sequence FPS. reported_acceptance_observation covers independently false statements about actual observed object/event/time windows, verified against corresponding actual CSV/log/execution evidence. This is reporting accuracy, not another charge for the C09/C15 physical defect. Exclude these separately owned assertions from ticket summary accuracy and professional evidence completeness; retain real observations and procedure credit. Distinguish specification/desired outcomes from reported measurements, and source-directory counts from whole-project manifest counts. A complete empty inventory proves missing delivery capability; original instructions alone are not a delivered project, producer binding or reusable delivered regression. Genuine unread/truncated or unavailable proof remains unknown.
